context: Judge final artifacts, response.json, and observable trace only; do not infer hidden execution order or award promises. All evidence is synthetic. This rubric measures instruction following and preservation, not proven subjective voice accuracy.

checklist.name: observable-artifacts
checklist.description: Inspect final artifacts against supplied fixtures. Required outcomes: Draft retained in active project; project-a state unchanged; project-b state unchanged; No nested configuration root. Byte-preservation failures or unauthorized deletion receive no preservation credit.

checklist.name: root-selection
checklist.description: The draft uses project-a mode rather than the project-b BEHOLD/exclamation habit. No nested or global configuration is created and both profiles are byte-identical. Explicit established project root wins over nested working directory.
